recommendation:
**These schemes serve DIFFERENT needs and can complement each other:**

🎯 **Choose APY if you want:** Guaranteed monthly income after retirement (age 60+). Best for informal/unorganised sector workers earning <tax slab who want long-term pension security. Requires commitment to contribute until age 60.

🎯 **Choose PMJJBY if you want:** Low-cost life cover to protect your family NOW (if you die before 50). Best for earning adults with dependents who need immediate financial safety net. Very affordable (₹436/year).

✅ **Best strategy:** Join BOTH if eligible. APY ensures YOUR retirement; PMJJBY protects your FAMILY's immediate needs if you pass away before age 60. PMJJBY is much cheaper and can complement APY's long-term planning.

⚠️ **Important:** This is AI guidance only, not official notification. Always verify eligibility (especially APY's income-tax payer bar) and consult your bank/post office or call the toll-free numbers before applying.
